WHY NOT sources/manual/wanted. That queue is for a page a browser can read and the
fetcher is refused, and its README says so. Only stegra-boden is that, and it is filed
there as well as here. The rest are the harder case: the page is readable and no company,
permit or grant decision states a date at all.
`press_only` rows are the ones to watch. A date EXISTS for them and is excluded because
it is trade press. That is the source rules working, not a gap in the research, and the
row's own note already carries the press date as press. If the rule is ever relaxed these
are the rows it would change.
